sources.entry: Iceshrimp.NET - Federated microblogging server that communicates over ActivityPub. (Source Code) EUPL-1.2 .NET/C#/Docker

summary.name: Iceshrimp.NET
summary.one_liner: Iceshrimp.NET is a federated microblogging server implementing ActivityPub, written as a new C#/.NET codebase continuing the Iceshrimp project.
use_cases: run a personal or community federated microblogging instance
use Mastodon client apps with a self-hosted server
contribute to a C#/.NET ActivityPub project
set up a decentralized social network for a community
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Iceshrimp as a decentralized, federated social networking service implementing the ActivityPub standard. The repository is a new codebase continuing the Iceshrimp project, focused on performance, stability and maintainability. Its Mastodon-compatible client API is said to be tested against third-party Mastodon clients, so users can use those apps instead of the bundled web UI. The project lists documentation and a feature comparison matrix for setting up instances, and a knowledgebase and chat room for developers. The repository is mainly C# with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and includes a Dockerfile.
notable: Mastodon-compatible client API tested against third-party clients
Focus on maintainability, stability and performance over features
Written in C#/.NET with a Dockerfile provided
caveats: Described as beta software; upgrading existing Iceshrimp-JS instances is not recommended yet
Not yet a stable release; the page says it will be ready when it's ready
The project does not operate a flagship instance
